description: This file defines an immutable Dart class called Annotation, used to model user annotations such as notes or highlights within a content-driven app. It includes fields for identifiers, offsets, colors, timestamps, and methods for serialization, copying, and utility purposes.

classes.name: Annotation
classes.description: An immutable data model representing a user annotation (highlight/note) with associated metadata such as colors, timestamps, and positional offsets, designed for use with SQLite persistence and app UI.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Annotation instance with updated fields.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Annotation object into a map suitable for SQLite database operations.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor to instantiate an Annotation from a SQLite row map.

methods.name: colorToInt
methods.description: Converts a Color object to its ARGB integer representation for storage.

methods.name: intToColor
methods.description: Converts an ARGB integer back to a Color object.

methods.name: newHighlight
methods.description: Utility method to create a default highlight annotation with optional timestamp.
